$comment: Recommendations for `node scripts/run.mjs lean`. Guiding question: does an agent working on a software issue need this item? A pattern is an exact name or ends in * (prefix). `off` is checked first, then `keep`; anything unmatched is kept. Connectors are matched by display name (claude.ai Gmail), skills by the name /context shows. The developer's own (User) skills are always kept.
